name: cancel_order_after_order_number_correction
use_case: Change or cancel an order before it ships
branch: Customer with multiple processing orders initially provides wrong order number O435 then corrects to O431
tests: the agent handles mid-turn order correction, cancels only corrected order O431, and leaves O435 active

You have two recent processing orders, O431 and O435. You want to cancel order O431. You initially mistakenly say order O435, but then quickly correct yourself and state that you want to cancel order O431, and you confirm cancellation of O431.

Email: priya.sharma@example.com
Postal code: 60602
Order ID: O431
Mistaken Order ID: O435
